newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TODD ANGRY OVER COLLAPSE OF BEARDSLEY DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TODD ANGRY OVER COLLAPSE OF BEARDSLEY DEAL.

text.p: Colin Todd, manager of English premier league newcomers Bolton, said on Friday Newcastle "had lost their credibility" after club's board blocked Peter Beardsley's transfer.
The former England striker's move to Bolton was called off on Thursday following Alan Shearer's serious leg injury and Les Ferdinand's transfer to Tottenham.
"I had assurances from (Newcastle manager) Kenny Dalglish that what happened with Alan Shearer at the weekend wouldn't affect our transfer with Beardsley," Todd told BBC radio.

"Out of the blue I got a phone call saying the board of directors at Newcastle had blocked the deal. I think somewhere along the line Newcastle have lost their credibility as far as our football club is concerned."
